correctness.rationale: For odd abelian A, every at in the nontrivial coset of Dih(A) has order two. In both the power and enhanced power graphs it has no neighbor other than the identity. The remaining nonidentity vertices of A partition into inverse pairs, yielding (m-1)/2 internal edges, and at most one coset vertex can be matched through the common identity. Hence the maximum is exactly (m+1)/2, and equality forces the stated saturation pattern.

Exact and alias searches found no generalized-dihedral matching formula for arbitrary odd abelian kernels.
residual_risks: The argument is elementary once the pendant-coset structure is isolated, so an equivalent observation could exist in an unindexed source or under different terminology.
The 2020 dihedral formula is a genuine special case and must not be described as new; novelty lies in the extension to arbitrary noncyclic odd abelian kernels and the exact deficiency interpretation.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact formula and maximum-matching structure for the natural infinite class of odd-kernel generalized dihedral groups, strictly extending the known ordinary-dihedral calculation. It also shows that the basic involution-versus-odd-order obstruction can be completely vacuous while the true deficiency is m-1, and identifies a broad family attaining the centralizer-based construction bound.
